title: L5: conflicts and duplication review of PRs #298–#337
public_pr_body:
Records one captured review of all 40 PRs with full heads/targets, direct and inherited overlap, duplicate versus complementary papers, and what must survive reconciliation.

All 780 local head pairs checked with git merge-tree: 33 text-conflict pairs, all listed; 747 clean pairs are not semantic approval. Covers CW's twelve replacement masters, corrected PQ/BA versus frozen CV, already-reconciled smoke, restriction corrections and unique evidence/handovers.

Inventory/count/source/whitespace checks passed. Handover embedded in docs/handover/CODEX-PR-CONFLICTS.md. No PR closed/merged/retargeted, main merge, production SQL, Ready label or runtime pass.
